results.system_description: 32x16 rectangular lattice, periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t' = 0; 448 electrons (224 up, 224 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.source_location: Table II (tab:2), row SCALE,hori, column t' = 0, Filled Stripe (λ = 8)
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the SCALE state with a horizontal filled stripe on the 32 × 16 PBC lattice at U = 8, 1/8 doping; the SCALE+GFMC rows are projected estimates and excluded.
results.notes: Table I caption: 'For results where statistical errors are not shown, they are one or several orders of magnitude smaller than the last displayed significant digit.' The statement is phrased for all results, so it also covers this value, printed without an error bar outside Table I. Recorded as an upper bound of one unit in the last printed digit. Sec. "Optimization and Ground State Projection" adds that, unless denoted with parentheses, the statistical error bars are one or several orders of magnitude smaller than the precision of the reported numbers in all tables. Horizontal: the rivers of holes run along the longer x direction (32 sites); vertical: along the shorter y direction (16 sites), as defined in the text after Table II. The stripe is selected by a temporary pinning field that is removed for the final optimization (Appendix C), so both rows are variational states of the same Hamiltonian. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.

results.system_description: 8x8 square lattice, periodic in both directions; U/t = -2 (attractive), t' = 0; 56 electrons (28 up, 28 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.source_location: Appendix D, table tab:app1, row SCALE, column 8 × 8, U = -2
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the SCALE state for the attractive Hubbard model; the +GFMC rows are projected estimates and excluded.
results.notes: Table I caption: 'For results where statistical errors are not shown, they are one or several orders of magnitude smaller than the last displayed significant digit.' The statement is phrased for all results, so it also covers this value, printed without an error bar outside Table I. Recorded as an upper bound of one unit in the last printed digit. Sec. "Optimization and Ground State Projection" adds that, unless denoted with parentheses, the statistical error bars are one or several orders of magnitude smaller than the precision of the reported numbers in all tables. Energy per site of the attractive Hamiltonian itself (spin-balanced, 1/8 hole doping, t' = 0; Sec. "Attractive Hubbard model"). The particle-hole transformation of Appendix A is unitary and maps U n_up n_down to U n_up (1 - n_down) with no constant, so no shift is applied (unlike the half-filled repulsive mapping E_att/N + |U|/2 of 2507.10705). Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
